Generate PDF From HTML.description: Renders an HTML string built from incoming data into a base64-encoded PDF.

Generate PDF And Get Download Link.description: Converts a web page to PDF and returns a temporary download URL instead of the file.

Generate Certificate In Sandbox.description: Generates a landscape certificate in sandbox mode, which doesn't use credits.

Generate PDF With Header And Footer.description: Adds a branded header and page-numbered footer to a generated PDF.

Convert HTML To PNG.description: Converts HTML to a PNG image using the generic request helper.

Get Credits Usage.description: Checks how many conversion credits have been used and remain this period.

List Recent Failed Conversions.description: Lists recent conversion logs filtered to errors.
